$comment: Where the vendored catalog.json came from, and — when it leads the published engine — why that is allowed. `sync-catalog.mjs --check` enforces every claim in this file, in both directions: an unexplained difference fails, and so does an `aheadOfPublished` marker that the publish has since caught up with.
why: LEADS the publish by two protocols, on the protocol-66 BRANCH only (core branch protocol-66-draw @ 43f1910, unpublished; v0.65.0 is on npm, v0.66.0 is the owner's tag). Vendored from that rev's crates/paged-introspect/catalog.json together with a wire.d.ts generated by a local build of the same rev: v65 (duplicateElements, the paragraph composer, caps/arrowheads on paths, effects on paths) and v66 (requestTextOutlines, the tree's pluginMetadata, the gesture pivot). When @paged-media/introspect-wasm@0.66.0 ships, re-run `sync-catalog.mjs --check` against it and take this marker off. History: the copy led the publish once before (capability-parity, v62→v63) and the allowance's shape is the thing worth keeping.
